task_contract_algorithm: sha256(json-sort-keys-compact projection excluding owner reviewer status next)

task.title: Shared runtime/task/audit lock protocol bootstrap
task.summary_zh: 在 48 個 primary task materialization 前，讓 runtime admission、canonical task state 與 activity audit 的所有 writer 共用穩定 inode lock，並以 process/crash/recovery evidence 證明可安全 dry-run/apply。
acceptance: exports exact protocol version 1 and rejects missing, partial, older, newer, or writer-digest-mismatched capability
acquires runtime admission, canonical task state, and activity audit locks in that exact order using never-replaced stable inodes
serializes every runtime queue/event, worker admission, approval, supervisor status, archive, audit append, scan, rotation, prune, replay, and outbox recovery writer
fails closed on missing, empty, malformed, unreadable, default-substituted, busy, queued, running, admitted, approval-suspended, duplicate, empty, or foreign task/runtime state
process-level inode-replace, contention, crash, kill, restart, concurrent writer, rotation, and outbox recovery tests preserve newest truth with no lost or duplicated events
exact merged bootstrap SHA passes a canonical strict live dry-run with zero writes before primary materialization is authorized
task.next: Admit a fleet worker to install and prove the shared runtime/task/audit lock protocol.
task.current_maturity: status-inode-local serialization with unverified runtime writers
desired_state_sources: canonical task state and activity audit protocol
proof_required: exact admitted task/run/provider/slot/worktree/scope/branch, PR, checks, merge SHA, and distinct-runtime review
concurrent writer, rotation, crash, restart, and outbox recovery matrix
canonical live dry-run before/after hashes bound to the merged bootstrap SHA
redacted checksummed evidence manifest and residual-risk verdict
non_goals: No seed fixture as live proof
No live-capital or live-broker side effect
dispatch_rules: start only as an external pre-dispatch prerequisite; do not run the primary dispatcher to bootstrap this task
implementation may be performed only by a supervisor-admitted fleet worker in a clean task worktree
owner and reviewer must be distinct admitted fleet runtime identities
the planner may author and validate this contract but may not edit any declared product artifact
missing or contradicted runtime evidence leaves the 48-task primary catalog blocked
